# A BBARI Enterprise

> B2B supplier of premium industrial hardware: V-belts, bearings, conveyor systems and power-transmission parts. Sales are quotation-based.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Company overview and featured industrial hardware.
- [Products](/products): Full catalog of belts, bearings and components.
- [Categories](/categories): Browse hardware by category.
- [About](/about): Company background and value proposition.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phones, emails and business hours.
- [Request a Quotation](/quotation): Submit cart for a price quote.

## Guides

- [V-Belt Selection and Maintenance Guide](/guides/v-belt-selection-and-maintenance): Technical guide to industrial V-belt types, sizing and wear identification.
